newsitem.title: Australia: RTRS-Australian bonds only outpeformed by Canada.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bonds only outpeformed by Canada.

text.p: Australian bonds were only outpaced by Canadian debt within the dollar bloc on the day after Australian September quarter inflation came in around the expected lower levels.

However, while the Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread ended below the psychological 100 basis points level, profit-taking and caution ahead of Thursday's August quarter average weekly ordinary time earnings (AWOTE) saw this margin above an early low of around 90 basis points.
The data is seen as a crucial component for the Reserve Bank if it is to ease policy again before the end of the year.
U.S. Treasuries, meanwhile, showed only a partial rebound in Tokyo after yields spiked up on supply concerns.
Canadian bonds surged ahead again after a weak Canadian CPI on Tuesday fuelled hopes of a further 25 basis point easing by the Bank of Canada.
However, the largest move on the day was against New Zealand, which finally buckled on profit-taking after its recent heady advance.
